info.title: PaperPlug Academic Search API
info.description: Free academic paper search engine querying OpenAlex (250M+ papers), arXiv, and Semantic Scholar with composite citation-velocity ranking.

get.summary: Search academic papers and scientific literature
get.description: Retrieves high-quality scholarly papers, peer-reviewed articles, and preprints from OpenAlex, arXiv, and Semantic Scholar with abstracts, citation counts, DOIs, and Open Access PDF URLs.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The research topic, keyword, scientific concept, or question to search for (e.g. 'transformer architecture attention mechanism', 'direct preference optimization', 'crispr off-target effects').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of top papers to return (default: 8, max: 15).

parameters.name: open_access_only
parameters.description: Set to true to only return papers with freely accessible Open Access PDF links.

200.description: Successful retrieval of ranked scholarly literature

citation_velocity.description: Average citations per year since publication

source.description: Sources where this paper was verified (OpenAlex, arXiv, Semantic Scholar)

abstract.description: Full abstract or summary of the paper
